Cozy Halloween Cabin Ambience

A cozy cabin on a stormy Halloween night. No music. No loops.

3 hours · 4K · 60 fps · no music · on YouTube

3:00:00
Subscribe on YouTube Watch on YouTube

fig. 01 about this film

What you'll see and hear

Rain patters on the roof and runs down the windows, thunder rolls over the mountains, and the fire crackles and sends up sparks. A black cat sleeps on the sheepskin by the hearth, until the thunder wakes her, or something drifts past. In the armchair beside her, a skeleton sips from a brass goblet and keeps an eye on the room. Jack-o'-lanterns glow among the candles, the old clock ticks and chimes the hour, and beyond the glass a violet storm sky hangs over an eerie green mist.

Every so often a ghost slips out of the wall and floats through the cabin, or drifts over the valley outside. Watch closely: the jack-o'-lanterns go out one by one and light again, a handprint appears on the misted window, a chess piece moves by itself and the other side answers, and once, a candle floats.

This is a real-time 3D world built from scratch, recorded one frame at a time in 4K 60fps. The picture and the sound are generated live, so nothing repeats: you'll never see or hear the same moment twice.

Leave it running for sleep, study, reading or a cozy October night.
